evidence.proved: the dataset is Common Crawl's own sample of the web, not a store for user data, so fails-quota on the storage filter stands
evidence.quote: Common Crawl's dataset is a sample of the web, and we do not generally archive any entire website but a randomly selected subset of it.

evidence.proved: HTTPS reads need no account; this makes the corpus a free read source but does not make it a store, so the storage verdict is unchanged (the read-source verdict lives on crawler-scraper/commoncrawl)
evidence.quote: There is no need to create an AWS account in order to access the data using this method.
